function.name: european_history_get_events
function.description: Provides a list of major historical events based on the specified country and century. Unlike european_history_get_culture, which provides cultural trends for a country and a century, this provides major historical events.

century.description: Century as an integer. For example, for the 1700s, input '18'.

event_type.description: Type of the event such as 'war', 'invention', 'revolution' etc. This field is optional. Default is 'all'

function.name: european_history_get_culture
function.description: Provides information on cultural trends, art movements, philosophical ideas based on the specified country and century. Unlike european_history_get_events, which provides major historical events, this provides cultural trends, art movements, and philosophical ideas.

century.description: Century as an integer. For example, for the 1700s, input '18'.

aspect.description: Aspect of culture such as 'literature', 'art', 'philosophy' etc. This field is optional. Default 'any'

function.name: european_history_get_monarchs
function.description: Provides a list of monarchs based on the specified country and century. Unlike european_history_get_events, which provides major historical events, this provides a list of monarchs.

century.description: Century as an integer. For example, for the 1700s, input '18'.
